stage_label: Stage 2: Linked to >=1 Associated Location (Direct or Billing Group)
plain_english_note: 26 (0.4%) had a directly linked location; 5,617 (95.3%) were linked only through billing organizations.

stage_label: Stage 3: Linked to a Single Pinpoint Practice ZIP5 (1 ZIP5 in 1 State)
plain_english_note: Only 588 (10.0%) mapped to a single pinpoint ZIP5, whereas 4,016 (68.1%) fanned out across large multi-site or multi-state billing organizations (mean 29.7, median 14 unique ZIP5s).
447 (7.6% of cohort; 76.0% of pinpoint sites) had a corroborated pinpoint ZIP5, and 2,300 (39.0%) had a practice ZIP5 corroborated across all supplied reference sources.
